target.statement: PCA baseline on SMD with Grid Search threshold, point-adjustment: average F1 = 0.930 (P=0.945, R=0.935)

compute.basis: PCA via PyOD on 28 small SMD machines (~1.4M points, 38 dims) plus POT thresholding is seconds-to-minutes of CPU; the paper's own code is not released, so the PCA+POT+GS pipeline must be re-implemented from the equations, but it is simple and deterministic.

blockers: Paper's own code/configs not released (only OmniAnomaly repo and PyOD are linked)
PCA anomaly-score formula (Eq. 9) and POT sign convention must be re-implemented from text
Exact GS threshold grid for PCA is only loosely specified (linearly spaced to match OmniAnomaly count)
title: Revisiting OmniAnomaly for Anomaly Detection: performance metrics and comparison with PCA-based models
